description: This file defines the class SiftBackend, a concrete implementation of the IAnalyticsBackend interface. It handles configuration, event sending, and internal action processing for the SIFT backend within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: SiftBackend
classes.description: Manages SIFT analysis backend operations, including event handling, configuration, and internal processing via a dedicated thread.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Overrides IAnalyticsBackend::SendEvent. Sends an event to the backend.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Overrides IAnalyticsBackend::Configure. Configures the backend with provided shell and system time.

methods.name: ActionLoop
methods.description: Internal thread method that processes queued actions.

methods.name: SendEventInternal
methods.description: Handles internal sending of an event with attributes.

methods.name: GenerateRandomOctetString
methods.description: Generates a string of random octets of specified length.
